cross-posted from: https://discuss.tchncs.de/post/69821510
[https://discuss.tchncs.de/post/69821510] > Hi, this is a project I’ve worked on
for a little bit. > > scaff is a static site generator aimed to be as simple as
possible. In it’s current state, it just generates webpages with no extra
frills. You create your templates in Go templated HTML, add your assets, write
your pages in Commonmark, and you do not have to do anything else. > > I am open
to comments about the project being posted here or on repository’s issues.
